values.value: 1. Open Asset {primaryRecordId} for {productName} ({quantity} @ {unitPrice}, installed {daysInstalled} days ago). 2. Confirm whether a Subscription / OrderItem exists for this asset. Likely no — that's why it's not being billed. 3. Build a corrective Order (manual or via amendment) that books the right quantity from {installDate} forward. 4. Decide retro-billing policy with finance: charge from install date, or only forward from today. 5. Inspect the provisioning → CPQ handoff. If provisioning creates Assets without backing Subscriptions, that's the systemic fix.
Subscription backfilled retroactively to install date.
Forward-only billing booked with finance approval.
Provisioning to CPQ handoff being fixed in next sprint.
